quadcopter.definition: A multirotor aircraft or drone that uses four rotors to create lift and control movement.
quadcopter.exampleUsage: The quadcopter lifted straight up from the marked landing area.

hexacopter.definition: A multirotor aircraft or drone that uses six rotors for lift and control.
hexacopter.exampleUsage: The hexacopter carried a camera for the mapping flight.

fixed-wing.definition: An aircraft or drone with stationary wings that creates lift mainly by moving forward through the air.
fixed-wing.exampleUsage: The fixed-wing drone covered a large area during the survey.

racing-drone.definition: A small, fast drone designed for competitive flying around a marked course, often using a live camera view.
racing-drone.exampleUsage: The racing drone passed quickly through the final gate.

fpv-drone.definition: A drone flown using a live video feed from an onboard camera so the pilot sees from the aircraft's viewpoint.
fpv-drone.exampleUsage: The pilot watched the FPV drone's camera feed on a display.

nano-drone.definition: A very small, lightweight drone designed for short-range flying, training, or indoor use.
nano-drone.exampleUsage: The nano drone was small enough to fly safely in the practice room.

delivery-drone.definition: An unmanned aircraft designed to carry and deliver small packages or supplies.
delivery-drone.exampleUsage: The delivery drone carried a small parcel to the test site.

survey-drone.definition: A drone equipped with cameras or sensors to collect measurements and images for mapping or inspection.
survey-drone.exampleUsage: The survey drone collected images for a map of the site.

agricultural-drone.definition: A drone used in farming for tasks such as crop monitoring, mapping, spraying, or spreading materials.
agricultural-drone.exampleUsage: The agricultural drone photographed the field to check crop health.

underwater-drone.definition: A remotely controlled or autonomous vehicle that moves underwater and uses cameras or sensors to inspect or explore.
underwater-drone.exampleUsage: The underwater drone inspected the structure below the surface.

propeller.definition: A mechanical device that rotates to push against air or water.
propeller.exampleUsage: The propeller was used during the activity.

motor.definition: A nonspecific agent that imparts motion.

frame.definition: The supporting shape or structure of a building.

battery.definition: A collection of related things intended for use together.

esc.definition: An electronic speed controller that regulates the power and speed of an electric motor in a drone.
esc.exampleUsage: Each motor is connected to an ESC that controls its speed.

flight-controller.definition: The onboard computer that reads sensors and commands, then stabilizes and controls a drone's movement.
flight-controller.exampleUsage: The flight controller adjusted the motors to keep the drone level.

gps-module.definition: A device that receives satellite signals to determine a drone's position.

antenna.definition: A device that sends or receives radio and television signals.
antenna.exampleUsage: The antenna was used during the activity.

camera.definition: Equipment for taking photographs (usually consisting of a lightproof box with a lens at one end and light-sensitive film at the other).

gimbal.definition: An appliance that allows an object (such as a ship's compass) to remain horizontal even as its support tips.

transmitter.definition: Equipment that sends a radio, television, or communication signal over a distance.

receiver.definition: Set that receives radio or tv signals.

joystick.definition: A lever used by a pilot to control the ailerons and elevators of an airplane.

throttle.definition: A pedal that controls the throttle valve.

yaw.definition: An erratic deflection from an intended course.

pitch.definition: The act of throwing a baseball or softball by the pitcher towards home plate, which initiates play by giving the batter a chance to hit it.

roll.definition: The side-to-side tilt of a drone around its lengthwise axis.

trim.definition: To balance in flight by regulating the control surfaces.

failsafe.definition: Designed to remain safe or reduce harm when a part, system, or process stops working properly.

return-to-home.arabicTranslation: مصطلح تقني أو أداة يُسمّى «ريتورن تو هومي»
return-to-home.definition: A drone function that automatically flies it back to its launch point.

soldering-iron.definition: A handheld tool with a heated tip used to melt and apply solder, a metal alloy that joins electrical parts.
soldering-iron.exampleUsage: The soldering iron was used during the activity.

multimeter.definition: A portable instrument that tests several features of electricity, including voltage, current, and resistance, in a circuit.
multimeter.exampleUsage: The multimeter was used during the activity.

screwdriver.definition: A hand tool with a handle and a tip for turning screws.
screwdriver.exampleUsage: The screwdriver was used during the activity.

hex-wrench.arabicTranslation: مصطلح تقني أو أداة يُسمّى «هيكس ورينتش»
hex-wrench.definition: A tool with a hexagonal tip used to turn matching screws.

pliers.definition: A hand tool with two handles used for gripping or cutting.
pliers.exampleUsage: The pliers was used during the activity.

heat-shrink.arabicTranslation: مصطلح تقني أو أداة يُسمّى «هيات شرينك»
heat-shrink.definition: Plastic tubing that tightens around a wire when heated.

zip-tie.definition: A plastic strip that tightens to hold cables or parts together.

loctite.definition: A brand of thread-locking liquid that helps prevent screws from loosening.

balance-charger.definition: A charger that keeps the cells of a battery at suitable voltages.

prop-balancer.arabicTranslation: مصطلح تقني أو أداة يُسمّى «بروب بالانكير»
prop-balancer.definition: A tool used to check and correct the balance of a drone propeller.

firmware.definition: (computer science) coded instructions that are stored permanently in read-only memory.

ground-station.arabicTranslation: مصطلح تقني أو أداة يُسمّى «جرووند ستاتيون»
ground-station.definition: A computer or controller used to monitor and direct a drone remotely.

flight-log.arabicTranslation: مصطلح تقني أو أداة يُسمّى «فليغت لوج»
flight-log.definition: A record of a drone's flight path, settings, and events.

waypoint.definition: A chosen location that a drone or vehicle travels through on a route.

geofence.definition: A virtual perimeter for a real-world geographic area.

telemetry.definition: Automatic transmission and measurement of data from remote sources by wire or radio or other means.

pid-tuning.arabicTranslation: مصطلح تقني أو أداة يُسمّى «بيد تونينج»
pid-tuning.definition: Adjusting flight-control settings that keep a drone stable.

calibration.definition: The act of checking or adjusting (by comparison with a standard) the accuracy of a measuring instrument.
calibration.exampleUsage: The calibration was used during the activity.

simulator.definition: A machine that simulates an environment for the purpose of training or research.
simulator.exampleUsage: The simulator was used during the activity.

registration.definition: The official recording of a drone or its owner with an authority.

license.definition: An official document giving permission to do something.

no-fly-zone.arabicTranslation: مصطلح تقني أو أداة يُسمّى «نو فلي زوني»
no-fly-zone.definition: An area where drone flights are prohibited or restricted.

visual-line-of-sight.arabicTranslation: مصطلح تقني أو أداة يُسمّى «فيسوال ليني وف سيغت»
visual-line-of-sight.definition: The ability to see a drone directly without viewing it through a screen.

altitude-limit.arabicTranslation: مصطلح تقني أو أداة يُسمّى «التيتودي ليميت»
altitude-limit.definition: The maximum height at which a drone is allowed to fly.

pre-flight-check.definition: An inspection and set of checks completed before takeoff to confirm that the aircraft and equipment are ready for safe operation.
pre-flight-check.exampleUsage: The team completed the pre-flight check before launching the drone.

spotter.definition: A worker employed at a dry-cleaning establishment to remove spots.

insurance.definition: Promise of reimbursement in the case of loss.

airspace.definition: The atmosphere above a nation that is deemed to be under its jurisdiction.

faa.definition: An agency in the Department of Transportation that is responsible for the safety of civilian aviation.
